First Week of College

September 20, 2025

Went to Red Bricks (some dorms) and saw people rolling down a steep hill in the move-in carts.

Met three DJs: DJ Hudson, DJ Owen, and another.

DJ Owen lives on my floor.

Chatted with a girl named Stella, pretty smart, intelligent, she is my neighbor, she is Persian and speaks Farsi I believe.

Met Adrien and Anya, from Quinn’s (my roommate) WOW group. Got to talk with them quite a bit. Very nice people.

Went to the beach with my WOW group. Spent 30-ish minutes in the ocean. Body surfing, hanging out with the guys from the WOW group.

My WOW leaders took me and another guy to their frat house. At Cal Poly, the frats are more dispersed. For this frat (Sigma PI), they have a house for Sophomores, Juniors, and Seniors. So each pledge class lives together in a house through each year. I was expecting the frat house to be in poor condition, but it wasn’t bad.

Went to dinner with some friends, my roommates, and some other girls, just fun to hang out. Had ice cream and frozen yogurt afterwards.

Went to Sand Dunes and had a bonfire with a lot of people. Went back to dorm room and hung out.

Dorm Tour - Click Image below to watch video of dorm tour

8/16/2025 CAED Shop Tech Training

Using beautiful CNC machines like a HAAS CNC Machine. Access to machines such as:

  • Metal and wood lathes

  • Welding Equipment

  • Most woodworking machines that would ever be needed

  • Most metalworking machines that would ever be needed

Two 8-hour days of training, a lot of it was just watching people demonstrate machines. Not too much hands-on, but should be a good job.

First day of work is 9/19/2025.

I have 7 hours of work scheduled per week. Should be applicable for the whole quarter, same schedule for whole quarter.

Designing a New Dorm Room Layout

Friends I made on the floor were annoyed by squeaking bunk beds. I measured their room and furniture, and proposed a new layout. Upon acceptance, I rearranged the room into the proposed layout. They were very happy to have it not squeak.

Helped other friends un-bunk their bed on the first day during move-in.

Went to a house party: lots of people from the SLO area who went to SLO High School. Left pretty swiftly, wasn’t my scene.

Went for a run today at 7:30 am with my roommates. They are pretty quick.

First day of classes

  • Introduction to theatre is a pretty large class, 200 students, 4 TAs, and one teacher.
    • I met a girl named Izzy in that class, she has her pilot’s license and is studying Mechanical Engineering. She asked for my phone number so we could study together.
  • Calc 3 was good: Professor Medina is a nice lady, I like her approach to the class.
    • Connected with a guy named Elan in my class, we exchanged phone numbers.
    • After class, we studied together in our dorm’s study space.
    • Did the calc homework.
    • Went to the professor’s office hours together to ask some questions.
    • He is from Santa Cruz, and is going to study computer engineering.

Met tons of people in my dorm. Tough for me to remember all of the names, but I am slowly getting it.

My RA is very chill. She doesn’t care too much, but still makes sure rules are followed.

Campus is beautiful, I love walking around (although walk to class is kind of long).

The food is pretty good in my opinion. Lots of good options.

Dorm room is mostly complete. Everyone we have shown it to really liked it. Goal was cozy, homey, and not average male dorm room. I think we achieved those metrics.

Went to the gym once or twice. Lots of people at the Rec Pool outside, tanning.

Played some beach volleyball at the sand courts 400 ft from my dorm building.

Getting close with a group:

Sammy from San Diego, Sophia from SLO, Owen from LA area, plus some other tag-alongs.

  • One night the 4 of us stayed up till 2:30 playing Mario Kart and talking.
  • Another night we were at dinner, with Quinn as well, and I suggested we hike to the top of a nearby mountain. There is a “P” made out of concrete on the hill above campus, and so it’s a popular hike. I suggested we go to the very top of the mountain. So we did. I brought headlamps because I knew we would be hiking back in the dark. We saw a tarantula.

Tyler and Quinn (my roommates) are really nice guys. I respect what they value: usually going to bed around 10:30, waking up around 7:00-7:30. We have done well at keeping our room clean and organized.

Tyler and I went for a walk up to the architectural grave yard is. Where ARCH projects are created by students.

Tons of super healthy people at Cal Poly. Everyone seems to value health and being active.

Random Thoughts

I appreciate the freedom to do what I want when I want. I think it’s cool how there are tons of students, indoor and outdoor, who are just sitting down at a laptop, doing work. Cool how between classes I have breaks where I can do what I look. Hang out with friends, do what I need to do. Do homework. The post office is really easy. I get an email when I have a package or mail arrived and I can go and pick it up. I have spoken with a lot of people, and my friends continually have said how outgoing and sociable I am. I knew I was that, but it’s interesting to have people notice that from the outside. It’s just who I am. I really have enjoyed talking to random people.

Researching which clubs to join, and putting a lot of intentional effort into where I will be investing my time. Lots of options in college, but important to be very choosy with what receives my time and effort.

Each day that passes is another day that either something happens, or doesn’t happen.

Everyone seems much more kind and sociable than at Lynden. Easier to have conversations with people. People are open to talking and just messing around. At Lynden, it was so cliquey.
